declaredBreaks.reason: AI agent thread responses (thread create, get and list, thread share clone, and the SDK binding type) can now return binding as { type: 'chart', chartUuid } as well as { type: 'dashboard', dashboardUuid }. Only threads created with the new chart binding return it; existing threads and dashboard-bound threads are unchanged. API clients and SDK hosts that read binding.dashboardUuid must check binding.type first. During a rolling update an old UI pod cannot render the header of a chart-bound thread until refresh.
